enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe steadily. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Stretch legs. Remain still. Breathe slowly. Turn again. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing, and taking morning medication
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up. Stand. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Wash hands and face. Brush teeth. Take medication. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Feeding the dog and preparing breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open dog food container. Scoop food into bowl. Place bowl on floor. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs. Cook eggs in pan. Toast bread. Pour milk. Set table.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating breakfast and sending one-on-one text check-ins to relatives
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Pick up phone. Open messaging app. Select relative. Type message. Send. Select another relative. Type message. Send. Finish eating. Place dishes in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Dressing and packing bag with clinic and school materials
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out clothes. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open bag. Place clinic materials in bag. Place school materials in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag.

enriched_activities.activity: School run and drop-off (walking and public transit, no EV needed)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Hold child's hand. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off at school stop. Walk to school entrance. Say goodbye to child. Hug child. Watch child enter school. Walk to bus stop. Wait for next bus.

enriched_activities.activity: Public transit commute to the clinic
enriched_activities.desc: Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Take out phone. Check messages. Reply to message. Put phone away. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to subway station. Tap card. Board train. Find seat. Sit down. Ride train. Get off at clinic stop. Walk to clinic.

enriched_activities.activity: On-site clinic duties and school aide support
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at clinic. Greet receptionist. Walk to office. Put down bag. Turn on computer. Check emails. Call first patient. Measure blood pressure. Record notes. Escort patient out. Call next patient. Administer medication. Assist teacher in classroom. Help student with assignment. Return to clinic. Update patient files. Answer phone. Schedule appointment. Organize supplies. Prepare for next visit.

enriched_activities.activity: Lunch break near the clinic
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafe. Enter cafe. Order sandwich. Pay cashier. Receive food. Find table. Sit down. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Check phone. Reply to text. Walk back to clinic.

enriched_activities.activity: Community health visits, client appointments, and errands
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to first client's home. Knock on door. Greet client. Enter home. Sit with client. Measure blood pressure. Ask questions. Provide medication. Record notes. Say goodbye. Walk to second client's home. Repeat visit. Walk to pharmacy. Pick up prescription. Walk to grocery store. Buy items. Walk back to clinic.

enriched_activities.activity: Public transit commute home
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Take out phone. Check messages. Reply to message. Put phone away. Get off bus. Walk to another bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off at home stop. Walk home.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking the dog around the neighborhood
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive home. Open door. Greet dog. Pick up leash. Attach leash to dog collar. Open door. Walk out. Walk down street. Dog stops to sniff. Pull leash gently. Continue walking. Turn corner. Walk around block. Dog urinates. Pick up poop with bag. Throw bag in trash. Walk back home. Open door. Remove leash. Pet dog.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan. Add meat. Add vegetables. Cook. Turn off stove. Place food on plates. Set table. Sit down. Eat dinner. Finish meal. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing schoolwork and homework materials at the dining table
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at dining table. Open bag. Take out schoolwork. Read instructions. Check child's answers. Circle mistakes. Write notes. Pick up phone. Search for explanation. Put phone down. Explain to child. Help with problem. Review completed work. Organize papers. Put back in bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Sorting and running laundry
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to laundry room. Open laundry basket. Sort whites and colors. Pick up white clothes. Place in washing machine. Add detergent. Close lid. Turn dial. Press start. Open dryer. Place clothes in dryer. Close door. Press start. Fold clothes. Put away.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening one-on-one text check-ins with relatives and neighbors
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Select relative. Type message. Send. Select another relative. Type message. Send. Select neighbor. Type message. Send. Read replies. Reply to messages. Put phone down.

enriched_activities.activity: Shower and evening hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on water. Wet body. Rinse. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off water. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Brush teeth. Put on pajamas. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV to unwind before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on bed. Flip through channels. Stop on a show. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel. Watch another show. Turn off TV. Put down remote.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking evening medication, preparing for bed, and setting alarms
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Pick up medication bottle. Open cap. Take one pill. Swallow with water. Close cap. Walk to bedroom. Pick up phone. Set alarm for 6:15. Plug phone into charger. Place phone on nightstand. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Breathe slowly. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Turn again. Remain asleep.
